note: Curated forward calendar for the Monday Week Ahead story (audit item 2, 2026-07-27). Only scheduled, publicly announced items belong here, each with a source URL. week_ahead.py renders this file deterministically every Monday; nothing in it may be a prediction. events.title: FOMC rate decision
events.detail: The Federal Open Market Committee meets Tuesday and Wednesday; the rate decision lands Wednesday at 2:00 p.m. Eastern with a press conference at 2:30. This meeting carries no Summary of Economic Projections, so there is no dot plot to parse.

events.title: Coinbase second-quarter results
events.detail: Coinbase reports second-quarter results after the U.S. market close, the largest listed crypto exchange's first report since the June market drawdown.

events.title: Strategy second-quarter results
events.detail: Strategy, the largest corporate bitcoin holder, reports second-quarter results after the close with a webinar at 5:00 p.m. Eastern; its bitcoin position marks to the quarter's prices.
